arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ يٰأَيُّهَا المُزَّمِّلُ
transliteration: Ya ayyuha almuzzammilu
translation: O thou wrapped up in thy raiment

arabic: قُمِ الَّيلَ إِلّا قَليلًا
transliteration: Qumi allayla illa qaleelan
translation: Keep vigil the night long, save a little

arabic: نِصفَهُ أَوِ انقُص مِنهُ قَليلًا
transliteration: Nisfahu awi onqus minhu qaleelan
translation: A half thereof, or abate a little thereof

arabic: أَو زِد عَلَيهِ وَرَتِّلِ القُرءانَ تَرتيلًا
transliteration: Aw zid AAalayhi warattili alqurana tarteelan
translation: Or add (a little) thereto - and chant the Qur'an in measure

arabic: إِنّا سَنُلقى عَلَيكَ قَولًا ثَقيلًا
transliteration: Inna sanulqee AAalayka qawlan thaqeelan
translation: For we shall charge thee with a word of weight

arabic: إِنَّ ناشِئَةَ الَّيلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطـًٔا وَأَقوَمُ قيلًا
transliteration: Inna nashiata allayli hiya ashaddu watan waaqwamu qeelan
translation: Lo! the vigil of the night is (a time) when impression is more keen and speech more certain

arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى النَّهارِ سَبحًا طَويلًا
transliteration: Inna laka fee alnnahari sabhan taweelan
translation: Lo! thou hast by day a chain of business

arabic: وَاذكُرِ اسمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّل إِلَيهِ تَبتيلًا
transliteration: Waothkuri isma rabbika watabattal ilayhi tabteelan
translation: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion

arabic: رَبُّ المَشرِقِ وَالمَغرِبِ لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا هُوَ فَاتَّخِذهُ وَكيلًا
transliteration: Rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi la ilaha illa huwa faittakhithhu wakeelan
translation: Lord of the East and the West; there is no Allah save Him; so choose thou Him alone for thy defender

arabic: وَاصبِر عَلىٰ ما يَقولونَ وَاهجُرهُم هَجرًا جَميلًا
transliteration: Waisbir AAala ma yaqooloona waohjurhum hajran jameelan
translation: And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave-taking

arabic: وَذَرنى وَالمُكَذِّبينَ أُولِى النَّعمَةِ وَمَهِّلهُم قَليلًا
transliteration: Watharnee waalmukaththibeena olee alnnaAAmati wamahhilhum qaleelan
translation: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile

arabic: إِنَّ لَدَينا أَنكالًا وَجَحيمًا
transliteration: Inna ladayna ankalan wajaheeman
translation: Lo! with Us are heavy fetters and a raging fire

arabic: وَطَعامًا ذا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذابًا أَليمًا
transliteration: WataAAaman tha ghussatin waAAathaban aleeman
translation: And food which choketh (the partaker), and a painful doom

arabic: يَومَ تَرجُفُ الأَرضُ وَالجِبالُ وَكانَتِ الجِبالُ كَثيبًا مَهيلًا
transliteration: Yawma tarjufu alardu waaljibalu wakanati aljibalu katheeban maheelan
translation: On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of running sand

arabic: إِنّا أَرسَلنا إِلَيكُم رَسولًا شٰهِدًا عَلَيكُم كَما أَرسَلنا إِلىٰ فِرعَونَ رَسولًا
transliteration: Inna arsalna ilaykum rasoolan shahidan AAalaykum kama arsalna ila firAAawna rasoolan
translation: Lo! We have sent unto you a messenger as witness against you, even as We sent unto Pharaoh a messenger

arabic: فَعَصىٰ فِرعَونُ الرَّسولَ فَأَخَذنٰهُ أَخذًا وَبيلًا
transliteration: FaAAasa firAAawnu alrrasoola faakhathnahu akhthan wabeelan
translation: But Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger, whereupon We seized him with no gentle grip

arabic: فَكَيفَ تَتَّقونَ إِن كَفَرتُم يَومًا يَجعَلُ الوِلدٰنَ شيبًا
transliteration: Fakayfa tattaqoona in kafartum yawman yajAAalu alwildana sheeban
translation: Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey

arabic: السَّماءُ مُنفَطِرٌ بِهِ كانَ وَعدُهُ مَفعولًا
transliteration: Alssamao munfatirun bihi kana waAAduhu mafAAoolan
translation: The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled

arabic: إِنَّ هٰذِهِ تَذكِرَةٌ فَمَن شاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبيلًا
transliteration: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan
translation: Lo! This is a Reminder. Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقومُ أَدنىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ الَّيلِ وَنِصفَهُ وَثُلُثَهُ وَطائِفَةٌ مِنَ الَّذينَ مَعَكَ وَاللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ الَّيلَ وَالنَّهارَ عَلِمَ أَن لَن تُحصوهُ فَتابَ عَلَيكُم فَاقرَءوا ما تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ القُرءانِ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكونُ مِنكُم مَرضىٰ وَءاخَرونَ يَضرِبونَ فِى الأَرضِ يَبتَغونَ مِن فَضلِ اللَّهِ وَءاخَرونَ يُقٰتِلونَ فى سَبيلِ اللَّهِ فَاقرَءوا ما تَيَسَّرَ مِنهُ وَأَقيمُوا الصَّلوٰةَ وَءاتُوا الزَّكوٰةَ وَأَقرِضُوا اللَّهَ قَرضًا حَسَنًا وَما تُقَدِّموا لِأَنفُسِكُم مِن خَيرٍ تَجِدوهُ عِندَ اللَّهِ هُوَ خَيرًا وَأَعظَمَ أَجرًا وَاستَغفِرُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ
transliteration: Inna rabbaka yaAAlamu annaka taqoomu adna min thuluthayi allayli wanisfahu wathuluthahu wataifatun mina allatheena maAAaka waAllahu yuqaddiru allayla waalnnahara AAalima an lan tuhsoohu fataba AAalaykum faiqraoo ma tayassara mina alqurani AAalima an sayakoonu minkum marda waakharoona yadriboona fee alardi yabtaghoona min fadli Allahi waakharoona yuqatiloona fee sabeeli Allahi faiqraoo ma tayassara minhu waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waaqridoo Allaha qardan hasanan wama tuqaddimoo lianfusikum min khayrin tajidoohu AAinda Allahi huwa khayran waaAAthama ajran waistaghfiroo Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun
translation: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful
